svg.title: GROUP BY throws the rows away. A window keeps them.
svg.desc: Eight input rows collapsed by GROUP BY into three, beside the same eight rows kept intact with a running-total column added, dashed PARTITION BY dividers between categories and a bracket marking the sliding frame. Below, sum(x) over the tied input 1,1,2,3,3,4 with a 1 PRECEDING frame gives 1,2,3,5,6,7 under ROWS and 2,2,4,8,8,10 under RANGE, with the tied pairs ringed in red.
svg.text: GROUP BY throws the rows away. A window keeps them.
GROUP BY: the rows are GONE
8 rows in, 3 rows out. The detail is gone.
the FRAME slides down, one row at a time. Nothing is discarded.
sum(x) over (1, 1, 2, 3, 3, 4) with a 1 PRECEDING frame
top-3-per-category window 330 ms vs correlated subquery cancelled at 5 m 07 s · running total + 3-month MA 85.7 ms
...and what does this cost at 10 million rows?
